title: Smoke

caption:
Part 1. The camp is closed for winter. Cabin seven has smoke. 🌲

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: In February, the only person allowed at Camp Pine Hollow is the caretaker. His name is Sam Ortiz. And Sam doesn't light fires.
scenes.image: a lone man in a heavy winter coat standing at the snowy gate of an empty summer camp at dusk

scenes.narration: It's his first winter on the job. Forty acres of snow. Twelve log cabins. A frozen lake. A truck that only starts when it feels like it.
scenes.image: a row of snow-buried log cabins beside a frozen lake under a grey winter sky

scenes.narration: The owner gave him one rule. Walk the grounds at dusk. Check the locks. Never go inside the cabins after dark.
scenes.image: an old man's gloved hand passing a heavy ring of iron keys to a younger man

scenes.narration: For six weeks, nothing. Snow. Crows. The lake groaning at night, like something turning over in its sleep.
scenes.image: a vast frozen lake at twilight with long cracks in the ice, black pines on the far shore

scenes.narration: Then, on a Tuesday, he smelled wood smoke.
scenes.image: a thin column of grey smoke rising above dark pine trees in still winter air

scenes.narration: It was coming from cabin seven. A thin grey thread, rising straight up into the windless sky.
scenes.image: a single snow-covered log cabin with smoke curling from its stone chimney at dusk

scenes.narration: The snow around the cabin was smooth. No tracks. No path. The padlock on the door was frozen solid.
scenes.image: close-up of a frost-covered padlock on a weathered cabin door, untouched snow below

scenes.narration: He wiped the frost off the window with his glove. Inside, a fire was burning in the woodstove.
scenes.image: a man's gloved hand wiping frost from a cabin window, warm orange light inside

scenes.narration: Twelve bunks. Every blanket folded tight, the way counselors fold them on the first day of camp. And on the stove, a coffee pot. Steaming.
scenes.image: inside a log cabin, neat bunks with folded wool blankets, an enamel coffee pot steaming on a woodstove

scenes.narration: Behind him, across the frozen lake, somebody rang the dinner bell.
scenes.image: an old iron camp bell on a wooden post across a frozen lake at dusk, its rope swinging
